title: Your free games today

game_of_the_day.name: Cloud Leap
game_of_the_day.pitch: A ball hops across floating pillars in time with a song, steering around spikes and gaps while collecting stars across levels.

games.pitch: Relaxing Klondike and Spider solitaire with big easy-to-read cards, no timer, unlimited undo and painted tea-party scenes to unlock.

games.name: Robin's Rescue: Bubble Shooter Garden
games.blurb: A calm, untimed bubble shooter: flick painted berries, match three and free the chicks tangled in the hedgerow, then restore Robin's garden.
games.pitch: A calm, untimed bubble shooter: flick painted berries, match three and free the chicks tangled in the hedgerow, then restore Robin's garden.

games.name: Peony Mahjong: Relaxing Tile Solitaire
games.blurb: Calm, untimed mahjong solitaire with big painted garden tiles: match free pairs across 46 layouts from a 16-tile seedling to the classic Turtle, and restore a watercolour garden.
games.pitch: Calm, untimed mahjong solitaire with big painted garden tiles: match free pairs across 46 layouts from a 16-tile seedling to the classic Turtle, and restore a watercolour garden.

Puzzle.name: Jelly Blocks: Block Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Drag squishy jelly blocks with tiny faces onto the board, clear rows and columns for combos, and decorate a kawaii dorm with your stars.

Puzzle.name: Boba Trio: Triple Match 3D
Puzzle.pitch: Tap kawaii boba, mochi, strawberries and plushies from a squishy 3D heap, match three alike in your tray and clear the cushion before time runs out.

Puzzle.name: Bowtwist: Pin Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Pop cute bow-pins out of squishy jelly plates, fill the colour gift boxes, collect kawaii stickers and decorate Momo's dorm room.

Puzzle.name: Sprinkle Sort: Cute Sort Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Pour sprinkles, boba and jelly between cute cups with faces until each holds one topping, then decorate a kawaii café. Every level is solvable.

Puzzle.name: Mochi Match: Match 3 & Dorm Decor
Puzzle.pitch: Swap squishy kawaii sweets, make rockets and rainbow balls, pop gift boxes and jelly ice, and spend your stars decorating a pastel dorm room and café.

Puzzle.name: Bubble Buns: Bubble Shooter Pop
Puzzle.pitch: Aim, bounce and pop squishy jelly bubbles with tiny faces to free baby bunnies, then decorate their cozy burrow.

Arcade.name: Bloop Stack: Block Tower Runner
Arcade.pitch: Tap to stack jelly blocks under a sliding blob so it clears rising walls, with perfect clears chaining into a double-point fever.

Arcade.name: NS-Shaft
Arcade.pitch: Drop down a endless shaft, hopping between platforms of different types while avoiding the spiked ceiling, with simple tap-to-steer controls and quick retries.

Arcade.name: Charge Fish
Arcade.pitch: Plug in your phone to cast, unplug to reel, and tilt to aim at fish.

Arcade.name: ¡Chef!
Arcade.pitch: Keep multiple kitchen items going at once in a canvas arcade game.

Arcade.name: Mood Game
Arcade.pitch: Pick a mood and play quick mini-games such as number guessing, click challenges and riddles.

Arcade.name: Dumpling Dash: Kawaii Cooking Rush
Arcade.pitch: Cook, top and serve boba, dumplings, ramen, sushi and shortcake to a queue of chibi friends across five kawaii restaurants, then upgrade your kitchen and fill a sticker album.

Action.name: Hollowtide: Sci-Fi Survival Thriller
Action.pitch: Sneak through a sunken candy-bright research base, hide from a machine that hunts by sound, and escape in five chapters or survive the daily Lights Out run.

Action.name: Voidlance: Space Fighter Combat
Action.pitch: Fly a starfighter from the cockpit: dogfight drone swarms in a candy-coloured asteroid belt, lock missiles on bombers and take a dreadnought apart piece by piece.

Action.name: Embersite: Tactical Extraction Shooter
Action.pitch: Drop into an open valley, scout robot patrols with binoculars, loot rarity crates, finish the contract and reach the extraction helicopter before the timer.

Action.name: Hivefall: Alien Horde Shooter
Action.pitch: Hold a candy-coloured alien outpost against hundreds of chunky bugs with a rifle, flamethrower, rockets, sentry turrets and orbital strikes.

Action.name: Space Game
Action.pitch: Blast through endless waves of enemies, swap and upgrade four weapons, and survive multi-phase bullet-hell boss fights.

Action.name: Wingfleet: Space Shooter Powered by Your AI Agents
Action.pitch: Your real coding sessions become wingman drones whose tool calls, passing tests and commits fuel missiles, shields and a super, so work becomes firepower.

Strategy.name: Rollhome: Ludo Board Game
Strategy.pitch: Roll the 3D die, bring tokens out on a six, capture rivals and race your colour home against three CPU players.

Strategy.name: The Last Pawn
Strategy.pitch: Play as a lone black pawn on a chessboard, swiping to dodge the white pieces' moves and capturing them to build a score.

Strategy.name: Rope Team: Mountain Climb for Your AI Agents
Strategy.pitch: Your coding agents' real activity drives a low-poly mountain ascent, while you choose routes at forks, anchor through gusts and spend gear.

Strategy.name: Quest Party: Dungeon Heroes for Your AI Agents
Strategy.pitch: Your real coding sessions become a dungeon party whose tool calls, test passes and commits trigger attacks, ultimates and treasure while you time abilities.

Strategy.name: Turf Rush
Strategy.pitch: Glide out of your turf, draw a loop and close it to claim land, while rivals try to cut your exposed trail.

Strategy.name: Briefcase Bluff
Strategy.pitch: Open 26 numbered briefcases, weigh the banker's rising offers against the remaining prize values, and gamble on whether to deal or keep going.

Racing.name: Lapwise: 3D Grand Prix Racing Game for Your AI Agents
Racing.pitch: Your coding agents' real tool calls, commits and deploys drive a team of cars around a 3D track while you engineer and race.

Racing.name: Zip Lanes: Traffic Racer
Racing.pitch: Swipe between lanes, weave through highway traffic at rising speed and chain close-call combos.

Racing.name: Thrill Loop: Roller Coaster Ride
Racing.pitch: Hold to build speed and release to brake, matching pace to track sections so every rider stays aboard through loops, jumps and hairpins.

Racing.name: Brick Climb
Racing.pitch: Race rivals across a brick-strewn floor, collecting only your colour to stack and lay as stairs, then climb first to the next level.

Racing.name: Marble Dash
Racing.pitch: Hold to roll a glossy marble down a wooden sky track, steering around red blocks and over boost pads toward the next level.

Racing.name: Dust Descent
Racing.pitch: Steer a first-person mountain bike down a dusty canyon, grabbing boost pads and passing five rivals to take first place.

Word & Math.name: Dailies Club: Daily Puzzle Set
Word & Math.pitch: Three cute daily puzzles in five minutes: find the four hidden groups, decode the emoji word and crack the mini logic grid, with Lulu the club kitty.

Word & Math.name: Doubloom: Slide Number Merge Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe to slide the number tiles, merge equal numbers into bigger ones and beat your best score.

Word & Math.name: Cagewise: Math Cage Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Fill the grid with no repeats in any row or column so every cage hits its target with + − × ÷.

Word & Math.name: Calmquill: Calm Crossword Game
Word & Math.pitch: Drag wooden letter tiles into a small themed crossword set against a painted landscape.

Word & Math.name: Tenpair: Digit Pairs Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Cross out equal digits or pairs that add up to 10, add rows when stuck, and clear the whole board.

Word & Math.name: Doublink: Chain Merge Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe a chain through matching and doubling tiles to merge them into ever bigger powers of two.

Idle.name: Liftoff Lab: Space Program for Your AI Agents
Idle.pitch: Coding agents' activity builds and fuels rockets at launch pads, then you steer each launch through rings to reach progressively farther planets.

Idle.name: Bellhop Boss
Idle.pitch: Drag your bellhop around a pastel hotel, checking in guests and collecting cash to buy new rooms and staff, unlocking themed floors.

Idle.name: Cookie Baker Clicker
Idle.pitch: Click the cookie and buy buildings and upgrades to bake more.

Idle.name: Idle Soccer
Idle.pitch: Manage a soccer team in an idle-style management game.

Idle.name: Rosewick Garden: Grow & Bloom
Idle.pitch: Plant, water and bloom twelve painted flowers, tie bouquets for storybook villagers, and design a walled garden of your own. Calm and untimed.

Idle.name: Pocket Pom: Cozy Pet Café
Idle.pitch: Run a tiny kawaii pet café: adopt cute pets, feed, play and groom them, serve boba to chibi customers and decorate. Pets never get sick, nothing is ever lost.

3D.name: Nova Lancer
3D.pitch: Pilot a Star Fox-style fighter through sunset seas, canyons and neon fortresses, then battle a giant mechanical sea serpent boss.

3D.name: Forager
3D.pitch: Fly as a honeybee through a procedural 3D meadow, decode the waggle dance, dodge predators, and see in ultraviolet.

3D.name: Operation Ironhold
3D.pitch: Clear a container yard of ten hostiles in three minutes using four weapons, ADS, double jumps and a sniper scope.

3D.name: JS13kGame2026
3D.pitch: Push deeper into the void, defend colored beacons through waves, pick upgrade cards, and take down bosses in desktop, mobile, or VR.

3D.name: Splat Tanks
3D.pitch: Drive toy tanks with up to 8 friends, splatting paint across the floor and growing bigger as you go.

3D.name: Cleanup Protocol
3D.pitch: Blast rogue household robots with an EMP water gun, grab breaker keys, and shut down the murderous SmartHub.

Sports.name: Kickoff Crew: Football Match for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents become football players, with their tool calls driving passes and shots while you coach through tactics, pep talks and timed finishes.

Sports.name: Pin Pals: Bowling League for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Bowl lane 1 with flick-aimed hook shots while your AI coding agents roll their own lanes, with task results deciding strikes, splits and turkey bonuses.

Sports.name: Plunge Peak: Cliff Diving
Sports.pitch: Leap off the cliff, hold to flip, let go to straighten up and rip a clean head-first entry.

Sports.name: Noggin Cup: 1v1 Soccer
Sports.pitch: Drag to run, tap to jump-kick and outscore a big-noggin rival in a 60-second 1v1 soccer match.

Sports.name: Hoopwing: Winged Basketball Hoops
Sports.pitch: Tap to flutter a winged basketball and drop it down through every hoop; clean swishes stack a fiery combo.

Sports.name: Swish Street: Basketball Shooting
Sports.pitch: Hold to charge a vertical meter, release in the green to swish hoops, with streaks, shifting city courts and level progression.

Cards.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

Cards.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
Cards.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

Cards.name: Kindred Cards: Word Category Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Open a category card, then stack every word that belongs to it before your moves run out.

Cards.name: Ridgeline: Peaks Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Chain cards one rank up or down to clear three peaks, building streaks across color-themed levels, with a daily seeded puzzle.

Cards.name: Teatime Solitaire: Klondike & Spider Card Game
Cards.pitch: Relaxing Klondike and Spider solitaire with big easy-to-read cards, no timer, unlimited undo and painted tea-party scenes to unlock.

Cards.name: Peakpatch: TriPeaks Solitaire Journey
Cards.pitch: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.

Kids.name: Beatbuds: Beat Maker Music Mix
Kids.pitch: Drag beats, effects, melodies and voices onto seven singing buds and hunt for the hidden combos.

Kids.name: Blubbo: Virtual Pet Care
Kids.pitch: Feed, wash, tuck in and dress up a squishy jelly pet, and play three mini-games together for coins.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.

Kids.name: Tinty: Pixel Color by Number
Kids.pitch: Pick a colour and drag to fill the numbered pixels of 57 cute pictures.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Makeover.name: Goo Lab: Slime Simulator ASMR
Makeover.pitch: Drip dyes into glue, stir to match the recipe card, then squish and poke the soft slime, with add-ins and scoring across stages.

Makeover.name: Glowfit Runway: Dress Up Fashion Battle
Makeover.pitch: Dress your chibi model for a themed brief, match the palette, strut the pastel runway and win the simulated fan vote against three rivals.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.
